keyword: what time did the oscars start
claims: The 2026 Oscars are the 98th Academy Awards.
The 2026 Oscars ceremony begins at 7 p.m. ET (4 p.m. PT) on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The official red carpet show precedes the 2026 Oscars ceremony at 6:30 p.m. ET (3:30 p.m. PT), according to the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences.
The 2026 Oscars ceremony is live on ABC, Hulu, and Fubo.
Conan O'Brien is the host of the 2026 Oscars.
